2014_spells.malicious-smite.fullDescript: Using 1 bonus action, the next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your attack deals an extra 4d6 necrotic damage. Additionally, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw; roll a d20, add the CON modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or be blinded until the spell ends.
